request_text: Fix diagnosed #3985 managed-skill retirement bug: local installer write builder must emit no physical effect for absent-to-absent while still retiring the stale manifest entry. Keep PhysicalEffect invariants and existing migration witness unchanged; add focused absent/real retired/shared-owner/no-churn controls. Route to active shared-parent owner with a separate RED/GREEN commit and supporting Op trail, preserving all other ownership and provisioning semantics.
